mapper.sql: a.id, a.score_id, a.sid, a.reason, a.status, a.new_total, a.handle_note, a.create_time, a.handle_time, a.handle_uid, st.name AS student_name, c.name AS course_name, s.total, s.course_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO score_appeal (score_id, sid, reason, status) VALUES (#{scoreId}, #{sid}, #{reason}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM score_appeal a LEFT JOIN student st ON st.sid = a.sid LEFT JOIN score s ON s.score_id = a.score_id LEFT JOIN course c ON c.course_id = s.course_id WHERE a.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM score_appeal a LEFT JOIN student st ON st.sid = a.sid LEFT JOIN score s ON s.score_id = a.score_id LEFT JOIN course c ON c.course_id = s.course_id WHERE a.sid = #{sid} ORDER BY a.id DESC
SELECT FROM score_appeal a LEFT JOIN student st ON st.sid = a.sid LEFT JOIN score s ON s.score_id = a.score_id LEFT JOIN course c ON c.course_id = s.course_id WHERE a.status = 0 ORDER BY a.id DESC
